say:3:1460461002:1.text: Hmph! Like a mere mortal would know what a real hero even looks like!
say:3:1460461002:1.source_cn: 哼，区区凡人，哪里懂得英雄真正的姿态！
say:3:1460461002:1.male: Hmph! Like a mere mortal would know what a real hero even looks like!
say:3:1460461002:1.female: Hmph! Like a mere mortal would know what a real hero even looks like!

say:4:1460461004:1.text: Anyway, that's not important! Dragons are symbols. What matters is, I'm here to save the world!
say:4:1460461004:1.source_cn: 总之，龙只是象征，我是拯救世界的英雄，这毋庸置疑！
say:4:1460461004:1.male: Anyway, that's not important! Dragons are symbols. What matters is, I'm here to save the world!

say:6:1460461005:1.text: Doubt me all you want! Heroes are always doubted! It comes with the cape!
say:6:1460461005:1.source_cn: 你、你要怀疑就怀疑好了，哪有英雄不会被质疑！
say:6:1460461005:1.male: Doubt me all you want! Heroes are always doubted! It comes with the cape!
say:6:1460461005:1.female: Doubt me all you want! Heroes are always doubted! It comes with the cape!

say:7:1460461007:1.text: "The world" is more of a... broad term. But I really am a hero!
say:7:1460461007:1.source_cn: 世界也就是个大概的范围，但我真的是英雄！

say:9:1460461008:1.text: Well, it takes commitment to become a great hero!
say:9:1460461008:1.source_cn: 坚定不移，绝不放弃，这就是英雄必备的品质！

say:9:1460461008:1.female: Well, it takes commitment to become a great hero!

say:10:1460461010:1.text: Sure, I only became a hero today, but the spirit's been there all along!
say:10:1460461010:1.source_cn: 虽然我今天才成为英雄，但意志从未改变！

say:12:1460461011:1.text: N-nothing major. Just a tiny problem. But I'm a hero, and heroes solve problems! So, nothing to worry about!
say:12:1460461011:1.source_cn: 没、没什么大事，一点小问题，只要我是英雄，我就能解决！

say:12:1460461011:1.female: N-nothing major. Just a tiny problem. But I'm a hero, and heroes solve problems! So, nothing to worry about!

say:17:1460461012:1.female: Exactly! A hero's destiny is to tackle whatever life throws at them!

say:18:1460461013:1.text: Well... a little problem came up, that's all. But I'm a hero, s-so I will fix it!
say:18:1460461013:1.source_cn: 就是今天遇到了点小问题……但我是英雄，一、一定能解决！

choice:8:1:2.male: When did you become a hero?
choice:8:1:2.female: When did you become a hero?

say:20:1460461006:1.text: ... W-well, you know, that one. I mean, have you been to the flowerbed on the next street over? I fixed it!
